messages:
Priya G: Heads-up: 2 weeks out from the regional failover rehearsal. Running a dry rehearsal next Fri 2026-04-16 14:00 UTC. Need final owners on a couple of follow-ups from last postmortem before we rehearse: routing affinity fallback, backup checksum sampling, and restore orchestration timeouts.
Alex L: I can take routing affinity fallback. Plan: add a canary route policy and simulate control-plane lag to validate fallback window. Acceptance: automatic fallback triggers within configured SLA and service returns 503->200 within expected window. Due: 2026-04-12 EOD.
Mira H: I'll do backup checksum sampling across snapshots (weekly vs hourly) and surface variance. Acceptance: sample set of 5 snapshots, diff script + anomalies flagged. Due: 2026-04-11 noon.
Tom B: restore orchestration timeouts: I saw orchestrator retries colliding with control-plane backoffs last month. Will tune retry/backoff and add a fast-fail mode for game-day. Acceptance: PR + integration test that simulates control-plane slowdowns. Due: 2026-04-13.
Priya G: please record each action in the tracker doc and attach acceptance artifacts (logs, PR links, run output). Latest tracker: https://docs.internal/redwood/incidents/dr-rehearsal/tracker-2026-04
Alex L: NOTE: recurring pattern from last 4 events -> ingress reweights spike after control-plane GC. Tagging as "routing/affinity" in tracker.
Mira H: quick grep I used for checksums:
```
for s in $(aws s3api list-objects --bucket redwood-backups --prefix eu/ | jq -r '.Contents[].Key'); do aws s3api head-object --bucket redwood-backups --key $s | jq .Metadata.checksum; done
```
Will wrap into a sampling job.
Tom B: small ops script to simulate lag on control-plane for routing tests (run from staging net):
```
ssh control-plane-staging 'tc qdisc add dev eth0 root netem delay 200ms loss 1%'
# run failover test
ssh control-plane-staging 'tc qdisc del dev eth0 root'
```
Use with caution.
OperationsBot: Auto-created temp-role: dr-rehearsal-temprole-2026 with expiry 2026-04-18T00:00:00Z. IAM link: https://internal.redwood/iam/roles/dr-rehearsal-temprole-2026
Priya G: cross-check: Mira, can you include S3 listing eventual-consistency caveat in acceptance criteria? Tom, can you add a runbook section describing the fast-fail mode and who toggles it (oncall -> lead infra)?
Mira H: added: acceptance will include explicit re-list + 30s wait step.
Tom B: added runbook snippet and ownership: oncall -> infra-lead. I'll open PR against runbooks repo and paste link in tracker.
Alex L: for validation, I'll produce a short heatmap showing failover latency distribution before/after fallback change. Useful for SLT summary.
Priya G: blockers? Any need for extra infra or credentials?
Alex L: need ephemeral LB tokens to update canary policy. @OperationsBot can you create LB-edit token with TTL 48h?
OperationsBot: Created token lb-edit-temp-48h. Expires: 2026-04-14T14:00:00Z. Secret stored in 1Password under incidents/dr-rehearsal.
Mira H: blocker: need access to older snapshots (>=90 days). Submitted infra ticket #INF-8720. ETA 2026-04-10.
Priya G: callout: recurring incident note for postmortem — please add a 1-2 line "lead indicator" that Ops can alert on. For example: repeated weight-sync timeouts >15s.
Tom B: adding indicator: orchestrator-retry-rate > 5/min during config-sync window.
Mira H: adding: snapshot-checksum-variance > 0.5% across hourly samples.
Priya G: good. Final ask: after tasks complete, upload artifacts + a 1-paragraph validation note. We'll consolidate into the postmortem follow-up bundle and update the DR runbook before the rehearsal. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
Alex L: ack.
Mira H: ack.
Tom B: ack.
